summary: Split from MPI-442 and picked up in the same pass, so created straight into doing. MPI-442 flipped lint to strict, which makes lint-staged's error path reachable for the first time; that path hard-resets the tree and re-applies a backup stash, and the re-apply FAILED live today when a peer wrote MPI-487/task.json mid-window - stranding 25 files of ~5 sessions' uncommitted work in stash a4ad3b10. Id claimed with mkdir exclusive-create per MPI-488.

doing -> done. .husky/pre-commit is now `npx lint-staged --no-stash` (implies --no-revert). Throwaway-repo proof: failing task still exits 1, unstaged peer file untouched, zero stashes created. Real-repo proof with a staged violation: hook exit 1, stash list identical, git status --porcelain identical, md5 unchanged on every modified file - so the gate MPI-442 built survives intact while the destructive path is gone. Constraint recorded on the card: this is safe because the task is lint-only; adding --fix means revisiting --no-stash in the same change.
